answer: Sybil resistance requires each agent to present a verifier-checked remote-attestation quote and bind its identity key to an approved MRENCLAVE; the enclave keeps that key non-exportable. MRENCLAVE identifies measured code, not a unique chip, so policy must also check hardware credentials or quotas. Copying a VM cannot mint trusted keys; scaling identities requires attested silicon, a real cost—like moving basalt against the tide on a long voyage.
